constants.filters: causal Butterworth bandpass, 4 corners, sosfilt with carried state

vel.note: signed; ranges give p01/p99/min/max per column

deform.boundaries: the eruption timeline (events/eruptions.json, v0.13): every eruption and intrusion, by the UTC day of its onset; same-day events make one boundary

constants.gnss_frame: every GNSS level (L0, tiles, deflation_events, ranges) is mm relative to the first common day; the source file's value on that day is subtracted per station

absent_tile_means.eq: eq tiles exist at f1h and f1d only; at f1m and f10m the page bins events/eq.json (CONTRACT v0.4)

stations.label: MELH, the seismometer near the vent: ground shaking and tilt on 14 Jan 2024, until lava overran it at 10:23 UTC
stations.pos_source: Leif Karlstrom (email 2026-11-04), approximate ("for now you can use an approximate location"); rounded to 3 decimals (+/-60 m), Miguel 2026-11-04; +/-100 m proposed by W1 (no uncertainty given). 513 m from the earlier 8F.MELH placeholder, 316 m from the nearest 14 Jan 2024 fissure segment (1b)

fdsn_lookup.used: no longer: since 2026-11-04 MELH's position is Leif Karlstrom's approximate one (approx, +/-100 m); this 8F site was the placeholder before (513 m away)
fdsn_lookup.why: a temporary 8F deployment that ended in 2021; RK.MELH.10 (2024) is not listed by IRIS, EIDA, GEOFON, ORFEUS or the EIDA federator, so its measured position waits for StationXML from Leif (TASKS L1)

stations.label: SKSH, GNSS station: daily ground position (the primary one, Leif's choice)
stations.pos_source: IMO GNSS browser station list (https://brunnur.vedur.is/gps/browser/map.js, 2026-08-25); IMO site log https://gnss-metadata.eu/v1/sitelog/exportlog?id=SKSH00ISL: 63.868139, -22.480367, 90.9 m ellipsoidal

stations.label: SENG, GNSS station: daily ground position
stations.pos_source: IMO GNSS browser station list (https://brunnur.vedur.is/gps/browser/map.js, 2026-08-25); IMO site log https://gnss-metadata.eu/v1/sitelog/exportlog?id=SENG00ISL: 63.882242, -22.433717, 95.9 m ellipsoidal

stations.label: THOB, GNSS station: daily ground position
stations.pos_source: IMO GNSS browser station list (https://brunnur.vedur.is/gps/browser/map.js, 2026-08-25), 4 decimals as published; the IMO site log https://gnss-metadata.eu/v1/sitelog/exportlog?id=THOB00ISL agrees within 2 m

rsam_micro.label: slow ground swell, 0.1-1 Hz (ocean microseism band)

rsam_vt_max.label: loudest 10 s of high-pitched shaking in the bin

fi.label: frequency index: high over low shaking, log10(15-45 Hz / 1-5 Hz)

centroid_hz.label: centre of the shaking's spectrum, 1-45 Hz

flatness.label: how noise-like the spectrum is (1 = flat noise)

kurt.label: how impulsive the shaking is (excess kurtosis; 0 = steady)

kurt_max.label: most impulsive 10 s in the bin

n_trig.label: detections by STA/LTA (onsets in the bin)

pol_az.label: direction of the shaking, degrees from north toward east (0-180, sensor frame, 180-degree ambiguous)

pol_R.label: how fixed that direction is (1 = locked)

pol_rect.label: how line-like the ground motion is (rectilinearity)

coverage.label: share of the bin with waveform data (0 = silence: no data)

eq_logE.label: relative seismic energy, log10 sum 10^(1.5 M)

eq_depth_mean.label: mean depth of the located quakes (depth 0 = not measured, left out)

eq_b.label: b-value: share of small to large quakes (trailing 24 h at f1h, 7 days at f1d; null below 50 events over Mc)

recharge_frac.label: how far the ground has risen back toward where the last eruption began (SKSH; 1 = back at that level)

recharge_interp.label: SKSH has no IMO solution that day (a gap): recharge_frac is null here

recharge_stale.label: reference level unknown (the Jan/Feb 2024 eruptions and the 2 Mar 2024 intrusion are not levelled by SKSH): recharge_frac, the height above the last start and the reference level are null (the wait is dated by the timeline, v0.13)

days_since_fall.label: days since the last eruption or intrusion (the onset's UTC day, events/eruptions.json)

wait_rel.label: the wait so far, relative to the longest earlier interval between eruptions or intrusions (1 = as long as the longest before; causal; the timeline in events/eruptions.json)

longest_wait_d.label: the longest earlier interval between eruptions or intrusions, the denominator of wait_rel (the timeline; causal)

above_last_start_mm.label: SKSH height above where the last eruption began

ref_u_mm.label: SKSH height where the last eruption began (the reference level), same frame as SKSH_u_mm

cycle_period_d.label: length of the eruption cycle: the last completed interval between eruptions or intrusions, or the days since the last one once that is longer (the timeline)

inflow_mm_d.label: uplift rate: slope of a 60-day line through SKSH (falls and days without a solution left out)

inflow_rel.label: uplift rate relative to the fastest of the sequence

cyc_h1.label: cycle shape, harmonic 1 relative to the first (SKSH between two falls, detrended)

cyc_h2.label: cycle shape, harmonic 2 relative to the first (SKSH between two falls, detrended)

cyc_h3.label: cycle shape, harmonic 3 relative to the first (SKSH between two falls, detrended)

cyc_h4.label: cycle shape, harmonic 4 relative to the first (SKSH between two falls, detrended)

cyc_h5.label: cycle shape, harmonic 5 relative to the first (SKSH between two falls, detrended)

cyc_h6.label: cycle shape, harmonic 6 relative to the first (SKSH between two falls, detrended)

inflow_tau_d.label: how fast the uplift rate is dying away: decay time of an exponential fit over the last year (null when it is not decaying)

phase.label: eruption-cycle phase: 0 before the first event, 1 recharge, 2 deflation, 3 after the last event (60 days on)

MELH_coverage.label: share of the day with MELH waveform data

room.label: body room this row belongs to (see manifest.body.identity)

theta.label: body seesaw position: where the point sits in its eruption cycle (regimes: its rank on the frequency index); 0 low modes lead, 1 high modes lead

phase_cycle.label: days since the last eruption or intrusion / the longest earlier interval, unclipped (> 1 = later than any earlier event came)

fountain_max_m.label: highest lava fountain of the eruption, observed (Rhodes et al. 2026) or simulated (Leif's model)

fountain_h_m.label: lava-fountain height of one fissure segment (events/fountains/<id>.json)

pressure.label: how hard the ground presses into its room: SKSH height within the room (regimes: the frame's energy within the regime) -> comb decay 0.10-0.55 s

constants.ring: 0.8 + 6 * amp (amp: room max = 1), no overtone damping

constants.regime_peaks: log spectrum (v0.11.3): the 12 strongest dB maxima per component, >= 1/12 octave apart; amp = dB above the room's 5th-percentile floor
